selection: earliest strict highest validation AUC; unchanged
threshold: one global per-model conservative empirical validation-real FPR10% rule; unchanged; fixed0.5 additionally reported
primary_reference: completed source-c332 FF++ D selected epoch1

bootstrap.method: paired connected recorded-contributor percentile; thresholds frozen; fixed eligible groups
bootstrap.inference: dataset-sampling uncertainty conditional on one trained seed, not training-seed variability

decision.reject: primary or AUC utility guard fails
decision.revise: primary/utility pass but any prespecified gender/age/worst-group/FNR guard fails, or bootstrap uninformative
decision.continue: all numerical guards pass and primary paired CI entirely below0 against D; only then prepare a separately recorded final-budget schedule; no automatic promotion or TEST

tie_break: if both satisfy continue, lower primary F_FPR; tie higher AUC; no new configs
